components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              format: int32

              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true

              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678')."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the canonical region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true

              title: Membership number

              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared identifier for the owner's household, the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode. All owners of the same last name and postcode share this value automatically; null when the owner has no postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The derived duplicate-detection key, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId. Two owners collide (409 on create) only when their whole identityKey is equal."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2C1D5E8B'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Numeric membership points assigned on creation. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for a tenure over 365 days."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric membership level assigned on creation, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode (the region-and-hash identity)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region, taken as the REGION part of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); this is the region derived from the postcode (postcode-preferred, city-table fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is not one of these."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration day before this owner was created, otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "True when, although not a hard duplicate, this owner shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone; otherwise false."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise null."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              description: "The preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band derived from birthDate, computed as full years from birthDate to registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied."

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained and still readable. False for a newly created owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The honorific title of the pet owner. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR. When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'."
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are preferred and this field is returned as the composed, normalized address."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' input; normalized like 'address'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is appended, after a single space, to the normalized 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares the same last name and postcode (the same household); such a request is created as a declared household member instead of being rejected as a duplicate. Optional; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation formatted as '<title> <lastName>', or just the last name when no title was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'

## Summary

I moved all date-derived owner values onto a fiscal-year basis (fiscal year starts 1 July, labelled by the calendar year it ends in — the Australian convention consistent with this app's AU regions/timezones).

**New helper** — `mapper/FiscalYear.java`:
- `endingYear(date)` — the fiscal year a date falls in (month ≥ July → next calendar year).
- `label(owner)` → `"FY<YY>"` from the owner's business-day-adjusted `registrationDate` (null-safe).
- `yearSegment(date)` — the two-digit `YY`, shared by the label and the membership number.
- `elapsedYears(owner)` — whole fiscal years (1-July boundaries) elapsed since registration.

**Wiring the change through:**
- `OwnerMapper` — added the `fiscalYear` mapping; the `membershipNumber` year segment now uses `FiscalYear.yearSegment(...)` instead of `registrationDate.getYear() % 100`.
- `MembershipLevel` — tenure points now trigger on `FiscalYear.elapsedYears(owner) > 1` (more than one elapsed fiscal year) rather than a 365-day window; removed the now-unused day-count code.
- `AuditOwnerCreated` — its inline membership-number string uses the same fiscal-year segment, keeping the audit log consistent with the DTO.
- `openapi.yml` — added the read-only `fiscalYear` property (source of the generated `OwnerDto.fiscalYear`) and updated the `membershipNumber`/`membershipPoints` descriptions.

Since `registrationDate` is stored already business-day-adjusted (rolled off weekends/holidays by `ResolveRegistrationDate`/`DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate`), every fiscal-year value derives from that adjusted date. The audit output confirms it end-to-end: input `2026-08-15` (a Saturday) rolls to Monday `2026-08-17`, which is in the fiscal year ending 2027 → `membershipNumber=...-M27` and `fiscalYear=FY27`.

One note on a spec ambiguity I had to resolve: `FY<YY>` uses the **ending** year (a Jul-2026 date → `FY27`). The acceptance test only pins the `FY\d{2}` format, so if you intended the *starting* year instead, that's a one-line change in `FiscalYear.endingYear`.
